description:
Explorer thumbnails for 326 file types Windows can't read, plus a right-click image toolkit.

SageThumbs 2K is a modern, crash-isolated Windows 11 shell extension written in Rust that rebuilds the classic SageThumbs. It gives File Explorer thumbnails for 326 file types Windows can't preview on its own — camera RAW, HEIC/AVIF, Photoshop, DjVu, ebooks and comics, video frames, 3D-print files and a long tail of obscure formats — plus a right-click image toolkit (convert, resize, rotate, OCR, color picker, metadata strip, combine-to-PDF/CBZ) and a console/AI CLI. Free for personal use.
Fixed
- The right-click preview shows the picture again, without recolouring your menu. Since 1.3.2
  the preview had been squashed into a strip a few pixels tall on PCs running a third-party menu
  skin such as StartAllBack or ExplorerPatcher. It is drawn full size on those PCs now, and
  everyone else keeps the menu exactly as Windows draws it. The two kinds of PC need the preview
  drawn two different ways, and SageThumbs now picks the right one for yours. There is nothing to
  configure: if you have never heard of a menu skin, nothing about your menu changes.
Added
- Music files show their album art. Pressing Space on an MP3, FLAC, M4A, OGG or WMA already
  played the track with a seek bar, but the picture area behind it was blank. It now shows the
  cover art stored in the file. Tracks without any keep the plain dark background.
Install: download SageThumbs2K-Setup-1.3.7.exe below and run it. Upgrading over an existing
install is fine; no need to uninstall first.
Checksums and build provenance are in SageThumbs2K-Setup-1.3.7.release.json.
